notes: Grammar: family-concept — one governing formation per concept shaped by its declared operation (64 distinct operations mapped: appearing-ring, cut, window-in-cage, broken token, merged disc, focal satellites, occupied centre, and so on); one definitional card (kicker = record_id + claim_status; italic = declared argument consumers, concept links, source_ids, capped with +n more — the exact lists are in this binding); body = the record's governing proposition compressed from the record's opening only.

Material: episteme register treatment per roz-corpus-base — print material on cooler paper #e9ece7, cooler ink #20262b: the instituted lattice. Status accent (Argued/Derived/Offered) is presentation-only encoding recorded in the family profile.
Text-layer sizes respect the engine minimum of 14 (sizes below 14 fail validateJourney: "Invalid page text" is also triggered by undersized text).
C scene ids are the lower-cased census record ids (c01…c64) per the collection README.
Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (episteme lane, records re-read at fc59a719 under submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/concepts/):

c01: the given disc walks the record's own list (a thought → a remembered scene → an ache → an act of judgment → “this is me”), each step growing/darkening as it becomes known; the ring never joins — repel pointer, breathing automation on the ring (appearing holds).
c02: attract pointer — the faithful definition draws the source in; warmer paper, slower dispersion (positive account).
c03: governing disc sequences the field → this (record: 'a field becomes this'), this grows and darkens; shove click = the cut.
c04: near-still operation that reproduces its bound — repel with edges weighted; camera eases back (transition 2.2).

c05: crossed-zero traversal 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 → 0/1 with tint/size objectStates (Ø darkest = occlusion); the two squares drift in opposed phase (the gap never closes); very weak repel (non-coincidence).

c06: the personal circuit I = Is → Who I am = What is → What I am = Who is? → I = Am, growing to its inward completion; two discs pulse in alternation (identification across difference); vortex click (the crossing).
c07: five conditions as a line layout; vortex pointer (the conditioning field); moss palette (worldhood as habitat).
c08: the frame's boundary — repel inside a tight radius, edge-weighted squares; slow speed (selection, not excuse).
c09: personed traversal knower → means → known → 180°→360°; excitation lfo = the luminous read-through; long transition (transparency develops).
c10: knower–means–known as three discs; attract (the means joins); body trimmed to ≤70 words, no claim changed.

c11: THE 3D SCENE — the compass plate: yantra centre at z −0.25 beneath, circumference ring at z 0, the ordering 00→01→10→11 walking the East–West diameter at z +0.15, N/S cardinal markers on the plate. Depth means: the four positions are borne by one traversable whole seen at an angle that shows the crossing across the diameter; centre = the untraversed aspect beneath the traversal. depthPerspective+occlusion+tint authored; vortex pointer (traversal).
c12: frozen script — the arrest: speed 0.07, turbulence 0.01, near-zero pointer (nothing reaches the criterion); flat earth palette.
c13: prakāśa–vimarśa — warm luminous field, attract (self-presence holds appearing and apprehending together).
c14: māyā as operative measure — the gnomon sequence five-by-five → 36−25 → 6²−5² → (6−5)(6+5) → 11 = 5+1+5 → six-by-six, growing to completion; dispersion lfo = contraction giving positive work.
c15: paśu — bounded horizon: repel with small radius; the disc's real capacities inside a finite ring.
c16: antaḥkaraṇa — inner instrument's offices in a column layout; attract (coordination).
c17: vikalpa → saṃkalpa — the two movements verbatim; alternatives scatter (high dispersion) and saṃkalpa gathers (smaller, denser); implode click = the gathering.

c18: apoha — a word → excludes other referents → not-non-pot → pot; the exclusion step slides toward the non-application ring with falling tintWeight (reach through what the mark does not apply to); ring drifts (the non-application field).

c19: pratyabhijñā — x → X → x with the middle grown and lit (the unknown expands capacity) and the returned x darker-edged (difference retained); triangle beat = the return; implode click (recognition gathers).
c20: arche-topos — place-making field: vortex/vortex with wide swirl (positions, poles, paths from one relation).
c21: living symbol — attract with halo (efficacy related to a source it does not exhaust); moss/earth (living).
c22: counterfeit symbolon — resemblance in the blocked return: shove click against a rust-ink field; slow, brittle roundness.
c23: severance — the strongest rupture: repel + shove, high turbulence (achieved difference misread as loss of relation).
c24: fusion — the opposite failure: implode click into a soft over-large disc (distinction erased); the journey's softest scene.

c25: counterfeit gathering — arranged grid of squares (differences arranged under a protected relation); attract with shove click (inclusion that can be revoked); italic authored from the record's own sentence.
c26: monoisation — local 1 → occupied source-office → field redescribed as derivative with the office swelling (scale lfo); vortex/vortex (the part turning the field around itself).
c27: protected account — insulated criterion: repel in a tight radius with edge-weighted square (the wall); dim, still field.
c28: covenant — binding to fidelity, scope and return: attract with steady pulse; blue/moss (a held relation).
c29: mediating office — vortex with weak strength (acts within a received field, does not source it); long transition (derivative, not originating).
c30: psychoid number (OFFERED kept on the kicker) — near-still luminous field with barely-there pointer (a research intuition held open); violet/slate.
c31: complex — salience grid with slow salience drift on the leading disc; attract (organises what can matter).
c32: archetype — vortex with irregular, haloed particles (the generative organisation drawn along paths no single interpretation commands).

Material character: concepts-1 keeps the print register — warm neutral papers, ink/slate/earth inks, rust reserved for the counterfeit/failure concepts (C22, C23, C25, C26, C27, C18's exclusion step), violet for the psychic/archetypal (C30, C32), moss for the living (C07, C16, C21, C28).
Beats: durations 12–16s and transitions 1.4–2.6 vary with the concept's tempo (arrests slow, ruptures snap, integrations lengthen); 9 automation lanes across the journey.

Sequences appear ONLY where the record itself is sequential (C01 list, C03 act, C05 crossed-zero, C06 circuit, C09 personed turn, C11 ordering, C14 gnomon, C17 two movements, C18 exclusion, C19 cross-reading, C26 reversal) — all step texts verbatim from the records at fc59a719.

glyph_rationales.0: unobjectifiable presence bracketing-prior — the kartṛ-pole of the crossed-zero recognition (C05)
glyph_rationales.1: unity affirmed with the differentiations retained (C05)
glyph_rationales.10: third cardinal placement — expression meets its inverse across the diameter (C11)
glyph_rationales.11: fourth cardinal placement — the crossing completed at the West (C11)
glyph_rationales./: the bare mark before assignment — two unassigned placements held by the slash (C03, C11's minimal form `/ = −/−`)
glyph_rationales.Ø: the slash fused into the zero — the means has taken the knower's office (C05; AC §2)
glyph_rationales.X: the expanded moment of the determining capacity — Taylor's notation (C19)
glyph_rationales.Ø/X: the slash becomes visible between subject-side occlusion and object-side determination (C05)
glyph_rationales.(0/Ø)/(1/X): the two recognitions held in one field of availability (C05)
glyph_rationales.0/1: the return that recognises the relation active throughout — ground and manifestation (C05, C01's field)
glyph_rationales.the field: the undetermined side of determination — what the act makes definite (C03)
glyph_rationales.this: the determined side — the field become distinguishable and addressable (C03)
glyph_rationales.a thought: a content that becomes known while the Subject does not become an appearance (C01's own list)
glyph_rationales.a remembered scene: a content that becomes known while the Subject does not become an appearance (C01's own list)
glyph_rationales.an ache: a content that becomes known while the Subject does not become an appearance (C01's own list)
glyph_rationales.an act of judgment: a content that becomes known while the Subject does not become an appearance (C01's own list)
glyph_rationales.“this is me”: the self-referential content in C01's list — known without converting the Subject into an item
glyph_rationales.I = Is: being spoken in its impersonal form — presence still said as something that is (C06 §5→0)
glyph_rationales.Who I am = What is: the identification unfolded through the articulated whole (C06 §5→0)
glyph_rationales.What I am = Who is?: the equating turned back toward the one performing it (C06 §5→0)
glyph_rationales.I = Am: the identification spoken from within — the traversed relation carried in it (C06 §5→0)
glyph_rationales.knower: first traversed position of the personed recognition (C09)
glyph_rationales.means: second traversed position of the personed recognition (C09)
glyph_rationales.known: third traversed position of the personed recognition (C09)
glyph_rationales.180°→360°: the turn that voids each view's exclusive completeness and returns the achieved relation (C09)
glyph_rationales.00: first cardinal placement of QL's ordering, borne by the whole circle (C11)
glyph_rationales.01: second cardinal placement — the walk's approach to the diameter (C11)
glyph_rationales.five-by-five: the bounded apparatus of the Sāṅkhya twenty-five in the gnomon reading (C14)
glyph_rationales.36−25: the exact difference the tattva-gnomon cross-reading names (C14)
glyph_rationales.6²−5²: the difference written as squares of the two gnomon sides (C14)
glyph_rationales.11 = 5+1+5: two five-unit strips and one new corner — Māyā's hinge (C14)
glyph_rationales.six-by-six: the completed square the difference builds (C14)
glyph_rationales.vikalpa: the movement that differentiates experience into qualified alternatives (C17)
glyph_rationales.saṃkalpa: the movement that gathers selected differences into intention or workable arrangement (C17)
glyph_rationales.a word: the mark whose application is at issue (C18)
glyph_rationales.excludes other referents: apoha's constitutive exclusion — the word's reach through non-application (C18, Pind PSV V:11d)
glyph_rationales.not-non-pot: the negative route by which the account reaches a pot (C18)
glyph_rationales.pot: the positive term reached through exclusion — determinate reach (C18)
glyph_rationales.x: the determining capacity as a particular — start and changed return of the cross-reading (C19, C34)
glyph_rationales.occupied source-office: the part seated in the whole's source-office (C26)
glyph_rationales.field redescribed as derivative: counter-generation — the conditioned field made to answer to the part (C26)
